mapper.insert: INSERT INTO street_area (name, introduction, cover_image_file_id, longitude, latitude, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{introduction}, #{coverImageFileId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE street_area SET name=#{name}, introduction=#{introduction}, cover_image_file_id=#{coverImageFileId}, longitude=#{longitude}, latitude=#{latitude}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, introduction, cover_image_file_id, longitude, latitude, status, created_at, updated_at FROM street_area WHERE id=#{id}
